subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Rarely
solution:
The most appropriate antonym of the given word **"rarely" is 1) Frequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word** "rarely"** means **occurring or happening infrequently, or not very often.**
 
• Therefore, the antonym of "**rarely**" would be a word that means happening often or repeatedly, which is "**frequently**."
 
 
• Example: I rarely </str
